## MUSA

MUSA is a cross-platform GPU computing framework that is based on the CUDA architecture.

## HIP

This provides GPU acceleration using an NVIDIA GPU. Make sure to have the [HIP toolkit](https://github.com/ROCmSoftwarePlatform/HIP) installed.

## Vulkan

This provides GPU acceleration using a Vulkan GPU. Make sure to have the [Vulkan SDK](https://developer.nvidia.com/open-source/vulkan-sdk) installed.

## CANN

This provides GPU acceleration using a Huawei GPU. Make sure to have the [CANN SDK](https://github.com/HuaweiLLaMA/cann-sdk) installed.

## ZenDNN

This provides GPU acceleration using a Huawei GPU. Make sure to have the [ZenDNN SDK](https://github.com/HuaweiLLaMA/zendnn-sdk) installed.
